source: Gemini 3.8 Flash (agy), targeted listening on short clips of the official video audio, captions excluded; 2026-10-21. Same model as recheck-gemini.json: one witness, not two.

places.question: Is the opening sung by one voice or by a choir?

segments.heard: Daz ouge, da inne ich got sihe
daz ist daz selbe ouge, da inne mich got sihet
min ouge und gotes ouge daz ist ein ouge

places.question: Is «daz ist ein» sung as two words or as one fused word «daz istein»?
places.answer: Sung as separate words («daz ist ein»), with «ist» and «ein» clearly articulated as two separate words, not as one fused word («istein» / «daz istein»).

segments.heard: gotes ouge daz ist ein ouge

places.question: Inside this line, is «إلا أنا» sung as an extra phrase near the end? When?
places.answer: No, «إلا أنا» is not sung as an extra phrase. It is sung exactly once from 236.5 s to 244.8 s (clip 00:12.5–00:20.8) as the regular final phrase of «وَمَنْ أَنَا يَا أَنَا إِلَّا أَنَا». There is no additional or repeated «إلا أنا» near the end; singing ends at ~244.8 s followed only by instrumental decay.

segments.heard: وَمَنْ أَنَا يَا أَنَا إِلَّا أَنَا

places.question: Are there sung words here? If so, which lines and when?
places.answer: Yes, after applause and bows until ~811 s, the choir sings three lines in Arabic from 811.2 s to 827.8 s.

segments.heard: وَمَنْ أَنَا يَا أَنَا إِلَّا أَنَا
